name: Greeks / IV-RV / VRP / volatility-surface integrated semantics and falsification contract

sharedConventions.underlyingReference: Freeze spot-index versus futures-underlying convention by experiment; never mix silently.
sharedConventions.dte: Exact expiry/date/time convention required; calendar-day versus trading-day DTE is versioned.
sharedConventions.rateDividendForward: Risk-free rate, dividend/forward method and source clock are versioned inputs.
sharedConventions.ivMethod: IV inversion model, bounds, filters, interpolation/extrapolation and solver tolerances are part of feature identity.
sharedConventions.units: Freeze whether volatility is decimal or percentage-point, variance or volatility, per-point or per-1%-move, annualized or horizon-specific.
sharedConventions.unknownRule: Missing/illiquid/unidentified inputs => UNKNOWN, never synthetic zero.

D12_13.name: Greeks: Delta / Gamma / Vega / Theta

coreSemantics.delta: Local first-order option-price sensitivity to underlying movement; also a local hedge-ratio object under a frozen model. It is not a probability oracle or market-direction vote.
coreSemantics.gamma: Local change in Delta per unit underlying move. Long standard calls/puts are positive Gamma; short positions are negative. Gamma magnitude is typically largest near ATM and can change rapidly near expiry.
coreSemantics.vega: Local option-price sensitivity to an implied-volatility change. Unit convention must state whether one 'vol point' means 1 percentage point.
coreSemantics.theta: Local option-price sensitivity to passage of time under frozen clock/model assumptions. Long-option Theta is generally negative in standard cases, but portfolio position, rates/dividends and nonstandard structures prevent a universal sign rule.

D12_13.jointRiskRule: Greeks interact and are state-dependent. A Delta-only or Vega-only narrative must not ignore simultaneous Gamma/Theta/IV changes.
D12_13.publicPositionGuard: Contract Greeks are computable conditional on model inputs; market-wide signed dealer exposure additionally requires position-side ownership. Reuse D12-08 identifiability firewall.
prohibitedInterpretations: Call/Put label alone determines market-maker Gamma sign
falsification: Compare Greek-derived features against simpler moneyness/DTE/OI/liquidity baselines.
Sensitivity to model, underlying convention, IV inversion and quote filters.
No stock-level use unless index/sector controls and incremental value are demonstrated.

maturityDecision.reason: Mechanism, sign/unit/model guards, identifiability limits and falsification are now explicit; no Taiwan prospective PIT/OOS evidence for L3.

D12_14.name: IV-RV Spread

coreSemantics.contemporaneousProxy: impliedVariance_t minus a frozen past-only forecast/proxy of physical future variance. This is a research proxy, not automatically the structural variance risk premium.
coreSemantics.trailingProxy: IV minus trailing realized-volatility/variance may describe richness versus recent realized conditions but mixes backward-looking realized state with forward option pricing.
coreSemantics.futureRealized: Future realized variance over the matched horizon is an outcome and is unavailable at t.

D12_14.requiredHorizonMatch: Implied horizon and physical-variance forecast/outcome must match as closely as possible; do not compare 30-day implied risk with arbitrary 5-day realized dispersion without an explicit mapping.
D12_14.estimatorGuard: D04 rolling close-to-close RV5/RV20 is not the same estimator as academic intraday realized variance. Preserve estimator identity.
D12_14.unitsGuard: Variance-minus-variance preferred for VRP semantics; volatility-minus-volatility must be named IV-RV volatility spread and not silently squared/unsquared.
falsification: Must add information beyond raw VIX/IV level/change and D04 ATR/realized-volatility Regime.
If only future realized variance produces the result, classify LOOK_AHEAD.
Test multiple frozen physical-variance forecasts without outcome-selected winner switching.
Stratify expiry, event, liquidity and surface-quality states.

maturityDecision.reason: Existing D12-05 VRP semantics plus D04 realized-volatility estimator guard are reconciled into a dedicated IV-RV contract; Taiwan PIT evidence remains pending.

D12_15.name: Volatility Risk Premium
D12_15.signConvention: VRP = risk-neutral expected variance minus physical expected variance. Literature using the opposite sign must be transformed explicitly, never mixed.
D12_15.structuralDefinition: Difference between risk-neutral expected future variance embedded in option prices and physical expected future variance over a matched horizon.
D12_15.exPostMeasure: Option-implied variance at t minus subsequently realized future variance is an ex-post realized premium/payoff estimator, not a live feature at t.
D12_15.modelFreeGuard: Evidence from classic aggregate-return research depends materially on model-free option-implied variance and high-frequency realized-variation measurement; Black-Scholes IV minus daily historical volatility is not the same object.
D12_15.horizonGuard: Published U.S./international return-predictability evidence is strongest at intermediate horizons in some samples; it does not authorize a Taiwan next-day directional rule.
falsification: Compare against VIX/IV level, IV-RV proxy, skew, rates/global risk and Taiwan Regime.
Test whether predictability survives alternative surface construction and realized-variance estimators.
Horizon pre-registration: next-open/next-session risk first; D5/D20 separately; no horizon shopping.
International/U.S. literature is mechanism evidence, not Taiwan Formal evidence.

maturityDecision.reason: Structural versus proxy versus ex-post semantics, horizon/model dependence and falsification are frozen; no source-attested Taiwan VRP series or OOS outcome evidence exists.

D12_16.name: Volatility Surface / Smile

surfaceIdentity.output: implied volatility or total implied variance

D12_16.constructionRisk: Sparse/noisy option quotes require interpolation/extrapolation. Surface method, quote filters and arbitrage constraints can materially change downstream variance/skew/VRP estimates.
arbitrageChecks: butterfly/strike convexity or equivalent no-static-arbitrage test
D12_16.taiwanEvidenceUse: Recent TAIFEX thesis evidence that slope/curvature were more OOS-predictable than level is hypothesis-generating only because it is a master's thesis and addresses surface-factor forecasting/economic strategies, not this project's 18:10 stock-selection objective.
falsification: Re-estimate results across at least two pre-specified reasonable construction methods.
Reject features whose sign/magnitude depends mainly on one interpolation/extrapolation choice.
Require quote-quality/coverage floors before surface factor is non-UNKNOWN.
Compare slope/curvature against simpler skew and term-structure features from D12-07.
Transaction-cost/Theta decay must be included before claiming tradable economic value.

maturityDecision.reason: Surface identity, quote/model/arbitrage risks, redundancy hierarchy and Taiwan-specific secondary evidence are defined; no validated Taiwan PIT surface receipt/builder for L3.

secondaryTaiwan: 2026 NCCU master's thesis on TAIFEX IV-surface factor predictability
evidenceHierarchy.promotionRule: Secondary thesis evidence may generate hypotheses but cannot alone support L3/L4 or Formal promotion.
